name: comfyclaude
description: Local image generation and editing for Claude: Z-Image Turbo, content-aware inpaint/outpaint, precise CPU recolouring, reference images, ControlNet, upscale and background removal. Free, private, runs on 6 GB GPUs.

comfyui_url.title: ComfyUI URL
comfyui_url.description: Address of your ComfyUI server (ComfyUI Desktop often uses port 8000, portable/manual installs 8188).

comfyui_path.title: ComfyUI folder (optional)
comfyui_path.description: Folder containing ComfyUI's main.py. When set, ComfyClaude starts ComfyUI automatically in the background when needed.

output_dir.title: Output folder (optional)
output_dir.description: Where generated images are saved. Default: ~/ComfyClaude/outputs
